title: Lower default_statistics_target 300->150 to cut planner/estimate cost on dominant GetUserTweets
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=300 inflates histogram/MCV build and planner estimate cost for the skewed user_id predicate driving 86% of terminal capacity; the r013 300->500 upward step was refuted, so the resolution axis is unresolved and a downward amplitude is justified.
mechanism: GetUserTweets consumes 86.5% of finite client terminal time at p50 121us with an Index Scan already chosen (plan_evidence uses_index=true), so the residual cost is per-call planning/estimate overhead rather than access-path choice. default_statistics_target=300 forces larger MCV/histogram arrays for the skewed user_id column, raising per-statement estimate cost on the hottest template. Lowering to 150 halves statistics resolution while keeping the Index Scan path; the r013 300->500 raise was refuted, so the downward direction is the untested safe amplitude.
query_effect: GetUserTweets remains on the Index Scan path (plan_evidence uses_index=true, estimated_rows=1); reduced statistics resolution lowers per-call estimate cost without changing the chosen plan.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase in successful_transaction_tps as terminal capacity freed from GetUserTweets planning overhead; bounded because the dominant cost is execution, not planning.
expected_latency_effect: Slight decrease in GetUserTweets p50/p95; no regression expected on InsertTweet or GetTweetsFromFollowing.

predictions.rationale: Lower statistics resolution cuts per-call estimate cost on the dominant template; r013 refuted the upward direction, so downward is the untested amplitude.
Tail of the dominant template should track the p50 improvement if planning overhead is the residual cost.
Freed terminal capacity from GetUserTweets converts to completed-transaction goodput.

alternatives.statement: If the Index Scan path and estimate cost are already minimal, lowering default_statistics_target leaves GetUserTweets latency unchanged and TPS flat.
If coarser statistics misestimate the skewed user_id predicate, GetUserTweets p95 could rise despite lower planning cost.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent sits at default_statistics_target=300 after the r013 300->500 raise was refuted; the downward amplitude 300->150 is untested and targets the dominant GetUserTweets planning overhead without disturbing the verified WAL commit-path bundle.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Lower from incumbent 300 to 150, inside allowed [50,500]; 2x reduction in histogram/MCV resolution, a larger safe downward amplitude than the refuted r013 300->500 upward step.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed user_id selectivity; lower target cuts histogram/MCV build and planner estimate cost

nodes.label: Reduced histogram/MCV resolution lowers per-call estimate cost on dominant GetUserTweets while keeping Index Scan
